shots.name: brand-to-product
shots.prompt: FINXIIT — OPENING MASTER, SHOT 1: BRAND TO PRODUCT. Create a premium cinematic 10-second 16:9 technology brand film, one unbroken smoothly controlled camera move, designed for a scroll-scrub website. Ingredient 1 is the EXACT original FinxiIT blue angular logo: preserve its silhouette, proportions and blue gradient; never replace it with an invented monogram. Ingredient 2 is the REAL FinxiIT home screen: use it faithfully as the screen texture of ONE elegant Android phone, preserve its layout, blue balance card, white rounded buttons and Portuguese interface; the data is a fictional demo. Environment is a deep midnight navy studio, cobalt-blue edge lights, restrained cyan, polished glass and brushed dark metal. Composition: all hero objects in the right half around x=74%, leave the left 45% dark and quiet for website copy. 0–3 seconds: begin with the large exact blue FinxiIT symbol floating as a beautiful thin solid emblem, crisp front view, soft blue rim glow, no Brazil or map visible. Slowly dolly toward the symbol. 3–6 seconds: a coherent blue light ribbon flows through the original emblem's angular opening, camera follows it, emblem becomes the logo on the back of a single Android phone, smooth reveal with no sudden cut. 6–10 seconds: phone rotates slowly to front, showing the referenced real home screen, screen remains flat, legible, stable, no invented numbers or UI. End with the full upright phone on the right, in 3/4 view nearly front-facing, cobalt rim glow and a thin luminous line continuing out of the right edge to motivate the next shot. Cinematic optical realism, deliberate elegant motion, no glitch, no particles storm, no rapid cuts, no text overlays, no subtitles, no additional brands, no watermark, no narration, no music. DO NOT show a map in this opening. Logo identity and authentic app screen are more important than elaborate effects. Do not add shops, stock retail imagery, coins, banknotes or cryptocurrency. End frame must be calm and usable as the start of an extension.

shots.name: product-to-people
shots.prompt: FINXIIT — CONTINUOUS SHOT 2: PRODUCT TO PEOPLE. Use the supplied image as the EXACT FIRST FRAME. Continue its same Android phone, same real FinxiIT home screen, cobalt connection ribbon, deep midnight navy and restrained cyan lighting. One unbroken cinematic 8-second 16:9 camera move. No new opening logo and no scene cut. 0–2 seconds: camera gently dollies backward from the phone on the right; reveal a Brazilian adult woman's hands naturally holding that SAME phone. 2–6 seconds: continue pulling back and reveal her using the app calmly in a contemporary technology workspace beside one Brazilian adult man reviewing his own phone. Natural believable faces, anatomically correct hands, everyday professional clothing, authentic unposed activity, accessible human technology. No shops, retail shelves, checkout counters, storefronts, fake holographic interface or business handshake. Keep the screen flat and stable, preserve the referenced interface as a texture, do not generate new menus or numbers. The app is an organizational assistant, not a bank: no money transfers, profit claims, cash or coins. People stay on the RIGHT HALF; keep the left 45 percent dark and quiet for website copy. The same single blue light ribbon connects their devices and travels beyond the frame. 6–8 seconds: camera begins a very gentle upward crane and ends in a composed wide view of the two people and the coherent blue connection line, ideal to extend into a national digital network next. Maintain polished dark glass, cobalt blue and optical realism from the reference. No abrupt edits, glitches, particle storms, additional logos, text overlays, subtitles, watermark, narration or music. Smooth deliberate movement throughout.

shots.name: people-to-connected-brazil
shots.prompt: FINXIIT — CONTINUOUS EXTENSION, SHOT 3: PEOPLE TO CONNECTED BRAZIL. Continue EXACTLY from the final frame of this film: the same woman in a cobalt blue blazer and the same man seated at the glass technology workspace on the right, the same Android devices, the same navy wall with cyan/cobalt connection lines. Do not restart the film. One seamless 8-second upward crane and camera pullback. 0–3 seconds: pull smoothly back and upward from the people, following the existing blue connection lines; the workspace becomes a small luminous node within a larger navy digital environment. Their devices connect into the same ribbon rather than vanishing suddenly. 3–6 seconds: the camera reveals that the expanded network forms the geographically recognizable upright silhouette of BRAZIL, north at top, with five broad regional luminous hubs joined by elegant thin cobalt paths. No spinning globe. Brazil settles on the RIGHT HALF around x=74 percent and fills about 40 percent of the frame, left 45 percent stays deep navy and clear for website typography. Refined polished dark glass, cobalt/cyan light, coherent optical perspective and depth from the existing film. This is a conceptual illustration of the company's purpose, NOT a claim of existing customer coverage. No user counts, customer pins, city names, location labels, statistics or coverage badges. 6–8 seconds: slow to a calm wide national connection view, blue lines gently glowing, cinematic navy background, stable end composition. Preserve the visual language of the real FinxiIT app and its original angular blue emblem if visible; do not invent a new logo. No stores, cash, coins, cryptocurrency, confetti, particle storms, giant holographic dashboards, generic corporate stock footage, abrupt cuts or glitches. No text overlays, subtitles, watermarks, narration or music. The final frame must feel like the same camera has traveled from app users to a connected country.
